sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Statutory Company Secretarial and Commercial Registered Agent Office

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), signed 29 June 2010, effective 12 September 2010
Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement, signed 9 August 2012, effective 1 February 2014

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: For the China-parent/WFOE limb: PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, Measures for the Management of Beneficial Owner Information (effective 1 November 2024), together with the Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revision, effective 1 January 2025). For the Taiwan registered entity: Money Laundering Control Act and the Company Act, Article 22-1, as implemented by MOEA beneficial-owner registration and company secretarial regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial and Industrial Services (Taiwan) or equivalent PRC SAMR registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize before a qualified notary public, then either (i) obtain a Hague Apostille from the designated competent authority if the issuing country and destination are Apostille Convention members, or (ii) obtain consular legalization from the destination consulate if either state is a non-member. These two routes are parallel and mutually exclusive; never apply an Apostille and then consular legalization to the same document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial and Industrial Services (Taiwan) or the relevant PRC market regulation bureau
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize and then either a sole Hague Apostille or a sole consular legalization depending on whether the origin/destination pair are Apostille Contracting States; do not chain Apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of CN_JV_LTD / proposed Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certify the resolution by the board secretary, notarize, and then apply either Hague Apostille or consular legalization by reference to the destination country's membership in the Apostille Convention; the two authentication methods are alternatives, never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Memorandum and Articles or equivalent Joint Venture Contract)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Execute before a notary public, authenticated by a sole Apostille if the receiving jurisdiction is an Apostille Contracting Party, or by consular legalization if the receiving jurisdiction is a non-member; no mixed or sequential authentication chain is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank of the corporate parent or the new entity's proposed bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issue on bank letterhead, sign by authorized bank officer, notarize if the bank requires, and legalize by either Apostille or consular route depending on the status of the states involved; Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive alternatives.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Screening must cover all beneficial owners, shareholders, directors, managers, authorized signatories, and counterparties before engagement and continuously during the relationship. The firm must run automated and human review against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU and UK financial sanctions, Taiwan MOJ anti-money-laundering blacklist, and PBOC terrorist financing lists, plus negative-news and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) databases. Enhanced due diligence is triggered by PEP status, high-risk jurisdictions, shell-company red flags, or medium-risk classification under ISIC 8299. Source of wealth and funds must be verified; transaction monitoring and annual or event-driven re-screening are mandatory, with senior management sign-off and five-year record retention.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Company and Commerce One-Stop Service Portal - Company Name and Business Scope Pre-review System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be in Traditional Chinese and contain a trade name plus a business-scope descriptor plus the company type (e.g. Limited). An English transliteration may be registered as a secondary name for banking and cross-border contracts but cannot replace the Chinese statutory name. Four-tier naming convention applies: (1) brand/trade name, (2) line-of-business descriptor, (3) liability suffix, and (4) any sensitive token requiring prior ministerial approval. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing name in the same industry registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If MOEA rejects the proposed name, the applicant should first request a written reason from the registry and, if the defect is fixable, immediately refile with a revised transliteration or trade name. A formal administrative appeal may be filed with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days of service under the Administrative Appeal Act; an adverse decision may then be appealed to the Taipei High Administrative Court. If the reservation is nearing expiration but incorporation is not complete, apply for an extension before the 180-day window lapses. Keep the original pre-approval number and file reference for all subsequent submissions.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable as the sole statutory registered office for a corporate-secretarial and registered-agent business in Taiwan. The tax authority, bank account-opening teams, and AML supervisors reject standalone virtual addresses because the ISIC 8299 business is considered a medium-risk shell-company enabler and must demonstrate physical management, accessible records, identifiable persons, and a genuine employment or agent presence. A serviced office with an actual lease, signboard, meeting space, local correspondence handling, and on-site personnel is the minimum compliant arrangement. A mailbox may be used only as a secondary correspondence address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: high, approximately 35-45% within the first 12 months of registration. Municipal tax bureaus and MOEA registry examiners may conduct unannounced on-site inspections to verify physical substance. Inspection checklist: original lease or ownership paper; visible company signboard; accessible statutory registers and books; physical meeting/reception space; evidence of local staff or professional registered agent; utility bills or bank statements matching the address; UBO and AML files; compliance with the registered business scope. Any mismatch between declared virtual address and actual location is an automatic AML red flag and a ground for revocation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024), Chapter II Arts. 42-101; Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2020), Arts. 5, 22 and 29; Implementing Regulations of the Foreign Investment Law (2020), Chapter III; Regulation on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (State Council Decree No. 746), Arts. 8-19; Measures for the Implementation of Company Registration in Foreign-Invested Enterprises; Law of the PRC on Protecting Taiwan Compatriots' Investment and its Implementing Rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) with statutory delegation to the local Municipal/District Market Supervision and Administration Bureau (MSA); filings are accepted at the district-level one-stop administrative service center or through the national 'Market Entity Registration Online Platform'.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Official company registration package comprising the Application for Market Entity Registration (公司登记（备案）申请书), the Articles of Association, and the Joint Venture Contract, culminating in the issuance of the Business License (营业执照) bearing the Unified Social Credit Code.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital for a general service-sector Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture under the 2020 Foreign Investment Law; the 2024 Company Law requires shareholders to pay the subscribed capital in full within five years of incorporation. No national escrow account is mandated, but a SAFE-monitored FDI capital base account must be opened with a designated bank, and the local MSA practises an expectation of at least RMB 100,000 paid-in capital to support the corporate-agency and secretarial licensing scope.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription of registered capital of this Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture, totaling USD 200,000 or the RMB equivalent, be and is hereby approved, with contributions paid per the capital contribution schedule annexed to the Articles of Association and within the five-year payment rule of the 2024 Company Law. RESOLVED further, that the registered office be fixed at the address stated in the Articles of Association, within the jurisdiction of the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau, and that all market entity registration filings be completed. RESOLVED further, that General Manager, Chief Compliance Officer, and Corporate Secretary be appointed, with full authority to open bank accounts, obtain the Business License, and complete all industrial, environmental, and civil-defense licensing matters.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Name Registration Self-Service System administered by SAMR through the local MSA online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the proposed Chinese name (plus English trade name) for a limited liability foreign-invested enterprise; undergo automated negative-rule screening against prohibited, misleading, and duplicate names; select the 'company type' as Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture; complete the independent name declaration and secure a 60-day reservation window. Also reserve the English branch/service mark if separately desired.
required_dossiers: Proposed Chinese and English corporate names (up to five alternatives)
Passport or identity certificate of the Taiwan investor
Identity document of the proposed legal representative
Outline of the intended business scope (ISIC 8299 corporate secretarial and commercial registered agent services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or the reservation expires, re-submit through the same online module with corrected name elements; an internal review appeal is available within 5 working days to the local MSA name-examination team, and a fresh name filing may be made immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Negative-List Screening and Taiwan Investment Status Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Discipline and Development Division of the local MSA jointly with the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) at the provincial level; Taiwan Affairs Office of the local government
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the business scope for automated comparison with the Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List 2024); confirm that statutory company secretarial and registered agent business support services fall outside all restricted/prohibited categories. For a Taiwan shareholder, obtain a Taiwan Compatriot Investment Status Confirmation Certificate from the local Taiwan Affairs Office to trigger equal treatment under the PRC law protecting Taiwan compatriots' investment and to streamline the registration.
required_dossiers: Completed foreign investment negative-list screening declaration form
Business scope description mapped to ISIC 8299 / NAICS 541199
Identity and eligibility certificates of the Taiwan shareholder
Joint Venture Contract excerpt evidencing the non-resident ownership percentages
Taiwan Compatriot Investment Status Confirmation application (where applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the scope triggers a negative-list item, amend the Articles of Association to carve out the restricted activity; if the Taiwan status certificate is queried, re-submit notarized shareholder identity documents and the recent business registration certificate from the Taiwan side; a 10-working-day supplementary review applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Notarization, and Execution of the Articles of Association and Joint Venture Contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The founding shareholders; a PRC notary public (公证处) for signature and chop authentication; optional counsel review by a licensed PRC law firm
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize bilingual (Chinese/English) Articles of Association and the Joint Venture Contract containing: corporate purpose confined to registered agent and offshore secretarial support services, registered capital and five-year contribution schedule, governance structure, board composition, legal representative designation, profit distribution, and liquidation clause. Arrange for the Taiwan shareholder's signature and company seal to be notarized by a PRC notary office, with legalisation simplified under the Taiwan compatriots regime where applicable.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association (Chinese original)
Draft Joint Venture Contract with shareholding ratio schedule
Capital contribution timetable aligned with the 2024 Company Law five-year rule
Notarized identity and authority documents of all signing parties
PRC legal opinion on the legality of the corporate secretarial scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is rejected due to incomplete identity seals, recure by obtaining a fresh notarized corporate seal certificate from the Taiwan shareholder and re-applying; substantive defects in the Articles may be cured by a supplementary shareholder written assent and re-execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Market Entity Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal or District Market Supervision and Administration Bureau (MSA) one-stop service window or the national online market-registration portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed Application for Market Entity Registration (公司登记（备案）申请书) together with the Articles of Association, Joint Venture Contract, lease certificate for the registered office, appointment instruments, and shareholder identity documents. Undergo online pre-review, pay no registration fee, and collect the Business License (营业执照) with the Unified Social Credit Code. Immediately afterwards, arrange the company seal engraving and the opening of a RMB basic deposit account at a bank designated for FDI inflows.
required_dossiers: Form C-01 - Application for Market Entity Registration
Articles of Association and Joint Venture Contract
Certificate of office lease (valid commercial-use lease or title deed)
Appointment letter and identity certificate of the legal representative
Appointment letters of directors, supervisor, and corporate secretary
Taiwan investor notarized identity and status certificates
Name pre-reservation certificate in original
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MSA issues a correction or query notice, remedy the checklist items and re-submit online within 5 working days; if the application is rejected on substantive grounds, amend the Articles and re-file after obtaining a new name reservation; administrative reconsideration or litigation remains available after final refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax, Social Insurance, Corporate Seal, and SAFE Foreign-Exchange Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local tax bureau (State Taxation Administration branch), local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, SAFE-designated bank, and the public security authority for seal record filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Leverage the 'one license, one code' regime to complete tax and social insurance registration automatically within 30 days of the Business License issuance; file for an invoice quota and VAT general/小规模 taxpayer classification with the tax bureau; open a foreign currency capital account at the designated bank and complete the FDI establishment information reporting with SAFE through the bank; carve and file the official company seal, finance seal, contract seal, legal representative seal, and invoice seal at the local public security-accredited seal carver.
required_dossiers: Business License original and Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Legal representative identity document and appointment letter
Bank account opening forms and licence copy
FDI establishment information and foreign exchange registration forms for SAFE
Tax-payer registration questionnaire and payroll policy statement
Seal engraving application form submitted to the accredited seal carver
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration data is inconsistent with MSA records, re-sync through the electronic tax bureau (全流程电子税务局) within 5 working days; if SAFE rejects the FDI filing, supplement the joint venture contract translation and capital verification confirmation from the designated bank and refile.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Books, Registered Office Readiness, and Commencement of Secretarial Service Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local MSA corporate archives; the registered office physical premises; the tax bureau for operational invoice issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Establish the statutory corporate records under the 2024 Company Law, including the shareholder register, board minutes book, share transfer ledger, seal usage log, and the legal representative's office records; affix the registered office signage and display the Business License as required; adopt internal anti-money-laundering and client-onboarding procedures appropriate to the medium-risk corporate secretarial business; submit the initial SEC (State Administration for Market Regulation) annual reporting segment and register the business site with the tax authority for invoicing readiness.
required_dossiers: Corporate seal ledger and sample imprints
Statutory registers (shareholder register, minutes book, seal usage book)
Registered office lease and landlord usage consent
Anti-money-laundering client due diligence policy
Tax invoice quota application and business commencement notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority rejects the invoice quota for lack of premises evidence, submit the water/electricity bill and the updated lease registration certificate; if statutory records are faulted at annual inspection, correct the registers within 5 working days and file an explanatory note with the local MSA.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Enterprise Registration Licensing Division of the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau (MSA); for the ancillary agency-bookkeeping sub-scope, the Municipal Bureau of Finance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License for Market Entity Registration (营业执照) with approved scope for ISIC 8299 business support services, supplemented by the Enterprise Registration Agency Practice Filing (企业登记代理机构备案) and, where bookkeeping services are added, the Agency Bookkeeping Permit (代理记账许可证书)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the PRC through the local Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau (生态环境局)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category IV service-sector, office-only activities without industrial discharge. Under the EIA Classified Management List for Construction Projects (2021), the pure corporate secretarial and registered agent office is fully exempt from the EIA Registration Form (登记表) requirement and requires no prior environmental clearance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or hazardous-waste obligations apply in an office-only environment; the premises must nevertheless observe the indoor air quality limits of GB/T 18883-2022 for office occupancy, municipal drainage compliance with GB 8978-1996 Category IV for sanitary sewage, and the hazardous-waste and electronic-media disposal rules of the Solid Waste Law (2020) for discarded client records, hard drives, and paper media.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety record filing at the local Fire and Rescue Division (消防救援机构) under GB 50016-2014, including a simple fire declaration for office floor areas below 300 m², fire-extinguisher placement, and evacuation signage; building occupancy clearance from the local housing authority confirming lawful commercial use via the structural completion acceptance record (建筑工程竣工验收备案) and the load-capacity certificate of the leased floor; occupational workplace clearance under the Work Safety Law, Articles 42 and 98, comprising a first-aid kit, emergency exit audit, and annual declaration through the national workplace-safety reporting system.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (財政部, MOF) acting through the Directorate-General of Taxation and the territorial National Taxation Bureaus (各地區國稅局); central taxpayer portal: MOF Tax Entry Portal (財政部稅務入口網, eiv.etax.nat.gov.tw); e-invoicing portal: E-Invoice Integration Service Platform (電子發票整合服務平台, www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a new Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture: (1) obtain foreign-investment approval from the Investment Review Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (投審會) under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; (2) obtain company-name pre-check and file incorporation with the MOEA Central Region Integration Service Center through the One-Stop Company and Commerce Online Application system; (3) the National Taxation Bureau automatically assigns the 8-digit Unified Invoice Number (統一編號, 'GUI number') as the statutory TIN/VAT registration identifier through the integrated registration channel; (4) complete tax domicile registration (稅籍登記/營業登記), income-tax withholding registration, and business tax (VAT) registration with the local National Taxation Bureau; (5) activate e-invoicing on the E-Invoice Integration Service Platform and select the Turnkey/API transmission channel. Fee: none for TIN issuance; legalization by a Taiwan court-affiliated notary or an overseas representative office may be required for the investor's corporate certificates.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box entity classification regime exists. Statutory elections and special rules available: (i) consolidated C.I.T. filing election for a domestic parent holding at least 90% direct/indirect equity in its Taiwan subsidiaries for 12 consecutive months (Income Tax Act Art. 39-1, effective tax year 2023); (ii) hybrid-mismatch deduction disallowance for payments involving dual-deduction or deduction-without-inclusion structures (Income Tax Act Art. 43-4, effective tax year 2024); (iii) CFC inclusion rules for controlled foreign companies; (iv) pre-approved non-calendar fiscal-year election; (v) small-scale simplified VAT assessment election for monthly turnover ≤ TWD 200,000; and (vi) for MNE groups with group revenue ≥ EUR 750 million, the global minimum top-up tax / IIR and QDMTT regime applies to Taiwan entities from 2025-2026. No pass-through election is available for corporate JVs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — value-added Business Tax (加值型營業稅) under the Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax Act (加值型及非加值型營業稅法)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover-based exemption: every business engaged in taxable activity must apply for VAT and tax domicile registration before commencing business. Small-scale businesses (小規模營業人) with average monthly turnover of TWD 200,000 or less may be assessed at the special 1% rate with simplified quarterly filing; full standard registration, 5% output tax, and bi-monthly filing are mandatory once average monthly turnover exceeds TWD 200,000. Foreign e-commerce platforms and vendors making B2C digital services into Taiwan must register via the simplified online foreign-unit platform.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing: all VAT-registered businesses must issue uniform invoices through the MOF E-Invoice Integration Service Platform and transmit invoice records to the National Taxation Bureau electronically. Transmission deadlines: generally within 48 hours of issuance; businesses with annual sales ≥ TWD 300,000,000 must transmit in near real-time (next business day) via Turnkey or web-service API. Required data fields include the seller's GUI number, buyer GUI number where applicable, item codes, taxable amounts, VAT amounts, and the auto-generated random-code digital stamp (隨機碼). Paper unified invoices remain lawful only for qualifying small-scale micro-businesses. The e-invoice platform record is the authoritative root file for zero-rated export reporting and input-credit refunds.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Business Tax Act Art. 7 zero-rating applies to: (i) exports of goods conducted through approved customs export procedures; (ii) goods sold for export with foreign-currency consideration; and (iii) services rendered to foreign enterprises or individuals for international transport or services provided to foreign clients and not used within Taiwan — this includes offshore corporate-secretarial, registered-agent, and compliance-administration services performed for non-resident clients, provided the benefit of the services is localized entirely outside Taiwan and consideration is received in foreign currency. Zero-rating is claimed period-by-period in the bi-monthly VAT return (filed by the 15th of the following month) with full substantiation; excess input VAT attributable to zero-rated supplies is refundable and is not subject to the monthly TWD 500,000 rolling-credit ceiling.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口報單) with verified shipment evidence
Commercial invoice in triplicate form (三聯式統一發票) tied to e-invoice platform records
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (for physical goods)
Foreign-currency inward remittance certificate (出口結匯水單) or bank FX receipt statement evidencing collection from the foreign buyer
Executed service agreement specifying offshore performance and non-Taiwan use (for services)
Proof of the counterparty's non-resident status (e.g., overseas registration certificate or tax residence certificate)
E-Invoice Integration Service Platform output record matching the declared zero-rated transaction
Intercompany or agency documentation proving the JV performed the substantive secretarial and registered-agent functions (economic substance evidence)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau may retroactively reassess zero-rating claims within the 7-year assessment period (核課期間) for non-reported or understated transactions and 5 years for fully reported transactions (Tax Collection Act Art. 21). If zero-rating is not substantiated, output VAT is restated at 5% with daily late interest from the original due date, input credits previously refunded are clawed back with interest, and an additional penalty of 5 to 7.5 times the evaded tax applies for fraudulent or willfully misstated claims (Business Tax Act Art. 51). Willful tax evasion by the responsible person carries criminal liability of imprisonment up to 5 years and/or a fine (Tax Collection Act Art. 41). Where export structures involve paper shell companies, sham transactions, or round-tripped funds, the tax authorities apply substance-over-form recharacterization, deny the zero-rating, and pursue joint liability against directors and ultimate shareholders.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC, 中央銀行) as the foreign-exchange and clearing-settlement authority in the Taiwan jurisdiction, supervised in banking conduct by the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC); counterpart mainland authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, which governs the PRC EJV shareholder's outbound investment registration, capital remittance, and repatriation of profits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Current account: TWD is fully convertible for bona fide service-trade receipts and disbursements under the Foreign Exchange Control Act (管理外匯條例), with Authorized Banks verifying underlying contracts, tax invoices, and CBC Remittance Classification Codes. Capital account: convertibility is materially restricted for mainland-origin investors under the Regulations for Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Area People; capital injection, equity acquisition, and increase of paid-in capital require prior approval from the MOEA Investment Review Department, and proceeds must be converted and settled only through the appointed Authorized Bank with CBC balance-of-payments reporting. Profit-remittance hurdles: dividend or fee remittances to the Chinese parent require (i) audited Taiwan financial statements and tax clearance; (ii) 20% withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, and reportable service fees paid to the mainland corporate shareholder under Article 25 of the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area; (iii) registration and verification at the Chinese parent's SAFE-located bank before the inbound dividend can be credited, including proof of source funds and the underlying Taiwan outbound remittance advice. PRC current-account convertibility is unrestricted for cross-border service-trade fee payments, but the Taiwan party must present a service contract, commercial invoice, and proof of tax payment to the remitting bank to pass SAFE bank-level authenticity review.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Taiwan: no statutory surrender ratio or mandatory conversion applies. Export and cross-border service-export receivables must be collected into the Taiwan entity's foreign-currency deposit account at an Authorized Bank within the commercial settlement period agreed in the underlying contract (bank-enforced at no later than 180 days unless extended), declared to the CBC through the bank upon receipt, and may thereafter be retained 100% in original currency or converted to TWD voluntarily at market rates. Mainland parent: SAFE imposes no mandatory conversion ratio since the 2012 settlement reform; however, goods-trade proceeds must be repatriated to China within 90 days of customs declaration, service-trade proceeds must be repatriated 'in a timely manner', every receipt must clear the Digital Foreign Exchange Registry, and the payment must be classified under the applicable PRC international-balance-of-payments service code for legal, accounting, and management consultancy services.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (mainland-investment proceeds settlement) / Operational Account
Operational Account / Offshore RMB (CNT) Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility with material legal constraints. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Currenxie, Revolut Business) are not licensed under the Taiwan Banking Act, cannot hold TWD deposits, provide no Taiwan-located account number, and cannot act as the CBC-designated Authorized Bank for remittance classification, mainland-investment escrow, or tax withholding. They may be deployed only as auxiliary collection channels for small-value fees from offshore clients after the local core banking relationship is active, subject to FSC rules on payment services and to Taiwan Personal Data Protection Act restrictions on transferring client beneficial-owner data to the PRC parent or third-country processors.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote-only opening is not permitted for mainland-funded corporate entities. The Taiwan-registered responsible person must physically attend the account-opening interview at the branch, present the registered company seal (公司大小章), original company registration certificate, business licence, and a mainland-notarised and SEF-verified power of attorney where a Taiwan resident deputy is authorised to act for the Chinese-entity director. FSC's 2021 AML revisions mandate face-to-face identification for Medium-Risk-Enhanced corporate clients; video-call steps may supplement but cannot replace the in-person interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO and statutory owner identified as a Mainland Chinese corporate shareholder (陸資), creating politically sensitive enhanced due-diligence and sanctions/embargo screening flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: MOEA Investment Review Department approval certificate; legalised joint-venture contract and amended articles of association; audited parent-company financial statements; SAFE outbound-investment registration receipt; bank reference letter from the Chinese shareholder's home bank; beneficial-ownership declaration with notarised passport/ID copies; Mainland notarisation and Taiwan SEF verification of all corporate authorization documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered-agent and company-secretarial business model resembles a nominee or shell-company service provider (designated non-financial business or profession risk under Taiwan AML law)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory licence evidencing the right to act as company-secretarial or commercial-registered agent; written AML/CFT policy with risk-tiered client acceptance; client acceptance register proving rejection of undisclosed-principal or PEP-related engagements; register of every client's UBO and intended corporate purpose; sample master-services agreements naming real client principals; three years of clean regulatory and tax filings of the Taiwan entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated entity with no balance-sheet history and a registered-office-only physical footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan with 24-month revenue and collection projections; committed client pipeline of at least three signed service contracts or binding letters of intent; physical office lease or co-working licence evidencing genuine presence; staff payroll and National Health Insurance contribution records; projected corporate income-tax filing calendar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting (AGM) minutes and approved financial statements filed with the Ministry of Economic Affairs (recordation under Company Act Article 230)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) – Department of Company Registration, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM must be convened within 6 months of fiscal year end (by 30 June for calendar-year companies); filed within 15 days after shareholder adoption
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance: MOEA notice and fines on responsible persons up to NT$500,000; continued failure may trigger compulsory dissolution by the MOEA

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: CPA-audited financial statements and statutory business report (required when paid-in capital ≥ NT$30 million or as ordered by competent authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) – attached to AGM filing; audited report retained at registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit completion before AGM; submission to MOEA within 15 days of formal shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain required CPA audit: fines on directors between NT$10,000 and NT$500,000; financial statements rejected; possible registration suspension

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (annual corporate income tax filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau (Ministry of Finance), Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May to 31 May for calendar-year filers; for fiscal-year enterprises, within 4 months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 3% per 2 days up to 10% of tax due; monthly fines up to NT$15,000 for zero-liability returns; understatement penalties up to 3× evaded tax; potential tax lien and criminal referral for willful evasion

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory CPA audit when paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million; also required for public companies under FSC rules or when the MOEA orders an audit due to suspicious financial statements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan IFRS (TIFRS) for public companies; non-public entities may apply Taiwan Business Entity Accounting Standards (local GAAP) consistent with the Commercial Accounting Act

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO filing is required for all private companies in Taiwan; however, licensed corporate secretarial agents and registered-office providers operate under the AML Act and must perform annual risk-based CDD/UBO reviews for each client, as well as within 15 days of any share transfer or material ownership change; the Register of Members must be updated accordingly

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% (applies to taxable income exceeding NT$120,000; the first NT$120,000 is taxed at 50% of the taxable amount, equivalent to a maximum of NT$60,000 on that bracket; effective standard rate on commercial-scale profits is 20%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday for ISIC 8299 company-secretarial/registered-agent businesses. Applicable preferences: (1) R&D expenditure tax credit of 15% (or 30% for advanced innovation under the Statute for Industrial Innovation) capped at 30% of the current-year CIT payable, creditable up to 10 years; (2) investment tax credits of 5% for automation equipment, smart production, and energy-saving devices; (3) 12% Alternative Minimum Tax floor under the Income Basic Tax Act (NT$600,000 basic-income exemption) applies where low-taxed profits would otherwise escape taxation; (4) 5% retained-earnings surtax on undistributed surplus imposes an additional entity-level burden on profits not distributed within the statutory window.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Settlement Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報書, Form 1 – General); filed electronically via the Ministry of Finance Electronic Tax Filing and Payment System (財政部電子申報繳稅服務網, https://tax.nat.gov.tw); the undistributed-surplus schedule (未分配盈餘申報書) is attached to the same filing package.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement return; one provisional advance payment installment is made mid-year (September) before the annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 5 months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year entities, by 31 May of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form 1, Section A – Company Identification (納稅義務人名稱及統一編號欄)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the Taiwan profit-seeking enterprise, unified business number (統一編號), industry code, registered address, and responsible-person identification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The JV must be registered as a Taiwan tax resident entity; the mainland Chinese parent must not be listed as the taxpayer. The responsible person (managing director) must sign and certify; a mainland director should be identified by passport and Taiwan-resident certificate if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 01 – Gross Operating Revenue (營業收入總額)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total invoiced consideration for company-secretarial, registered-office, nominee-director, offshore-administration, and ancillary consulting services; reconciled to the VAT uniform-invoice monthly filing (401 form).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize revenue on an accrual basis and issue uniform invoices for all fees, including those invoiced to the mainland parent. Service fees paid by the mainland parent must be benchmarked at arm's length; mischaracterization as royalties would expose the income to a 20% royalty withholding characterization issue. Omission of cash or wire fees constitutes fraudulent understatement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs including outsourced secretarial filings, statutory agent fees paid to external law firms, licensing fees, and direct staff assigned to client engagements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible only with supporting vouchers (contracts, invoices, bank-debit evidence); payments to the mainland parent for subcontracted services must satisfy the benefit test and TP documentation. Nondeductible payments to shell suppliers will be added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses: wages, rent, electricity, telecommunications, insurance, depreciation, professional indemnity premiums, and tax-exempt penalties (government fines are nondeductible).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Salaries of expatriate directors/staff are deductible only if employment services are actually rendered in Taiwan and monthly withholding tax (6%/18%) has been remitted; expenses paid to related parties abroad require an arm's-length benchmark and economic-substance justification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 33 / 53 – Operating Net Profit and Non-Operating Income (營業淨利及營業外收支)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile gross profit minus expenses to operating profit; then add non-operating items: bank deposit interest, FX gains/losses, and penalty income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest income from Taiwanese bank deposits is subject to 15% final withholding and is creditable against CIT; loan interest receivable from the mainland parent must be priced at arm's length and reported as taxable interest income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule 13 (帳外調整) and Loss Carryforward Schedule – Taxable Income (課稅所得額)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute taxable income after statutory book-tax differences, nondeductible expenses, exemptions, and offset of net operating losses (NOL) carried forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: NOL may offset up to 10 years. A JV whose mainland parent conducts related-party transactions must disclose book-tax differences; failure to maintain accounting books triggers deemed assessment under the same-industry profit standard, which for secretarial services is materially disadvantageous.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line – Tax Payable Computation (應納稅額) and AMT Comparison
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the progressive bracket (50% of first NT$120,000; 20% of the excess), then subtract statutory credits (R&D, foreign tax credits, investment credits) and compare with the 12% AMT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The mainland parent cannot claim the JV's credits or losses through flow-through; no foreign tax credit is available to the Taiwanese entity on profits already taxed in mainland China. If the computed tax is below the AMT floor, the AMT difference is payable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule on Undistributed Surplus (未分配盈餘申報書)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute the 5% surtax on undistributed retained earnings in excess of legally distributable surplus, after offsetting deficits and statutory reserves.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the JV resolves to distribute dividends to the mainland parent before the filing date, the retained-earnings surtax base is reduced; dividend distribution is then subject to the 21% non-resident withholding (see treaty-relief protocol for possible 10%/5% reduction, subject to implementation caveats).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: a delinquency penalty equal to 3% of the assessed tax for each month of delay, capped at 30%, plus interest at the postal savings one-year fixed rate; if the return is filed but tax is understated, a penalty of 2x the underpaid tax (2–3x in cases of fraud) plus interest; failure to file at all triggers ex-officio assessment by the tax authority with compulsory execution against corporate and responsible-person assets.
